scenes.narration: Netflix made 45 billion dollars last year. Here's where it comes from.
More than 325 million paid memberships, paying anywhere from about 1 to 37 dollars a month, depending on the country and plan.
Its cheaper plan with ads is growing fast. Ad revenue hit 1.5 billion dollars in 2025, about two and a half times the year before.
And Netflix expects ad revenue to roughly double again in 2026.
After paying for all those shows, Netflix kept about 30 cents of operating profit on every dollar. Follow for more.
